title: Colonal Llama
description: Add Colonal's Skin to your Lammas Pink Carpet!
body:
he Colonal Llama Resource Pack adds Colonals Skin to the your Llamas when equipped with a Pink Carpet!

It is themed around Colonal's love of Pink Slime, and optimized for to be used in the [Colonal Mod Pack (CMP)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/colonal-pack).
